test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 12 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
D, E, L, M, R, S, Y and Z are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table. Four of them are sitting at each of the corners, while the other four are sitting at the exact centre of each of the sides.

D sits in the middle of one of the sides of the table. Only one person sits between D and E. L sits to the immediate right of E. Only three people sit between L and M when counted from the right of L. R is an immediate neighbour of L. S sits to the immediate left of Y. Who sits third to the right of Z?
solution:
• D, E, L, M, R, S, Y and Z are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table.
 
• Four of them are sitting at each of the corners, while the other four are sitting at the exact centre of each of the sides.​

1) D sits in the middle of one of the sides of the table.

2) Only one person sits between D and E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/225b7bad4748cfbd50d6bf1bdf13e636996165eefb5d1d98e40b0e903c3d26f7.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2cf682ef90d3bb41a5afdea3ead1191bcf1e8d0c1d94f9b9a251cd8a16984332.png] 

3) L sits to the immediate right of E.

4) Only three people sit between L and M when counted from the right of L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea942c07364d4196ad198b580255acc8e1de0ba838df17b37d71ff844ebd59fe.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1791c4fca2cef4494a9ba674fc6db39ef69e8c84f6e7e5fd06a594e50e0b5b38.png] 

5) R is an immediate neighbour of L.

Case-II is not possible.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e1dd124a9505844da57d319dd291af3c0be753c11f61aa9a4821d8045009e8b.png] 

6) S sits to the immediate left of Y.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/246bc6d51a311adba943ecb4f2270af87862f116fdbcda344f1c0ceb1e23a40f.png] 

7) Only Z is left and one position is left so the final sitting arragment is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d817a9d54039ca3a43c95db232e47a87c89c14c989d6c5228015d0b22ff7a764.png] 

Thus, “R” sits third to the right of Z.
